name: Hyatt Place New York City - Times Square

reviews.roomType: Standard King Room with Sofa Bed
reviews.title: Great for the price. Would use again
reviews.liked: Location great, staff very helpful, room allocated as requested . Main bed super comfy, very good value
reviews.disliked: Sofa bed was fine for one night - not a great mattress. Breakfast was ok - decent choice but not great quality however it was complimentary so hard to complain

reviews.title: I expected more from Hyatt brand
reviews.liked: The location is very good . The room is clean
reviews.disliked: The shower is terrible ! Almost no water .. to wash my long hair took 30 minutes !!!

reviews.title: A comfortable, clean and safe environment in a very central location
reviews.liked: The location was excellent, very central but also far from any noise and noisy crowds. The breakfast was abundant yet needs to improve variety and include more charcuterie and fresh tomatoes etc. The tea, coffee and juice selection was brilliant though. Every floor has a water and ice dispenser which was very convenient.
reviews.disliked: The breakfast variety was limited. The amount was abundant and enough for the whole of the hotel guests but during our 1 week stay we would have appreciated a different menu and more charcuterie products.
